one_liner: Linear is a product development and issue tracking system with a public GraphQL API, webhooks, and an official MCP server for agents.
access_notes: API available on Free plan; higher plans raise limits

evidence.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Linear’s public API is built using GraphQL… In addition to querying, Linear has full support for mutating all entities.
Only workspace admins, or OAuth applications with the `admin` scope, can create or read webhooks.
Requests authenticated using an API key or an OAuth app receive rate limits based on the workspace’s plan… Free, Basic | Standard limits; Business | 2x; Enterprise | 5x.
The Linear MCP server… The interactive setup flow uses OAuth 2.1… You can also authenticate directly with a bearer token or Linear API key.
